resources.string: Everything here is backed up
Shown when every album in view has files and none are waiting to be sent. It comes from the app\'s own record; the Cloud\'s own answer is the last line of each album card.
Optimised and Saved
With **Sync** selected: how many files in Sync albums have been optimised, and the space saved.\n\nThe originals stay in the Cloud. **Restore** brings them back. See “How optimising works”.
Files archived and Scheduled to leave this phone

With **Archive** selected:

• **N files archived · X in your Cloud:** files that have left the phone, and the space their copies take in the Cloud.
• **N Scheduled to leave this phone:** files still on the phone in Archive albums, not counting files you chose to keep. **Nothing left to archive** when there are none.

Nothing is removed here. Removal happens on the Archive tab. See “How Archive works, step by step”.
Sync now, Rescan, Pause, Resume and Stop

## When nothing is running

• **Sync now:** backs up now. If an Optimise switch in Settings is on with its **Mode** set to **Manual**, it then optimises too (see “Mode: Automatic or Manual”). Greyed out when there is nothing to send or optimise.
• **Rescan:** looks at the phone and asks OneDrive again.

## While a backup runs

• Progress shows as **Syncing** with a percentage (by data, not file count).
• **Pause:** holds all backups until **Resume**.
• **Stop:** ends this run. Automatic backups carry on.

## Good to know

• **Sync now** does not wait for the charger, but still follows your Wi-Fi setting. See “Use mobile data”.
• It backs up every album set to **Backup**, **Sync** or **Archive**, but only ever optimises files in **Sync** albums.
The status line under the card

• **While uploading:** the file count, the file being sent, and its progress.\n• **While preparing:** **Scanning...** or **No permission to read media.**\n• **After a run:** a summary of what applies: **uploaded**, **already in the Cloud**, **no longer on this phone**, **failed**, **waiting on the Cloud** (tried again later), **still to go**, or **stopped:** with the reason.
The Albums Tab

## Header

• Tap **Backup**, **Sync**, **Archive** or **Off** to show only the albums in that mode. Tap **All Albums** to show them all again.
• The line under the buttons gives the total for each mode.

## Album cards

• **Name, file count and size** of the album on your phone.
• **Second line** (only when needed): how many files are optimised, kept at full size, pending or failed.
• **Cloud line:** **verified in OneDrive** means OneDrive confirmed the files at the right size. It is checked each time you open the tab. Other Clouds show **sent to** that Cloud.
• **Mode button** (right side): tap to change the album's mode. Archive asks you to confirm first. If the album's Cloud cannot do that mode, the card says so.
• **Tap the card** to see the album's files. See “An album's file list”.
An album\'s file list

Opens when you tap an album card.

• **Header:** back arrow, album name, mode and file count, the counts (“File marks and counts in an album”), **Sort by** (“Sorting an album's files”) and **Keep at full size** (“Keep at full size”).
• **Files:** one card per file with its size, date and marks. An optimised file shows its smaller size on the phone.
• **Camera folder** (if chosen in Settings): extra optimise controls. See “Optimise older photos and videos in your Camera folder”.

No thumbnails or previews. Use your gallery app to look at photos.
File marks and counts in an album

• **✓ backed up:** in the Cloud, full size on the phone.
• **✓ backed up · optimised:** in the Cloud; the phone has a smaller copy.
• **⟳ pending:** waiting to be sent.
• **✗ failed:** could not be sent after several tries.

## Retry failed

**Retry** puts failed files back in the queue and starts a backup. It removes nothing.
Keep at full size

A checkbox beside files that **Restore** brought back. While selected, GallerySync leaves that file alone:

• In a **Sync** album, it is not optimised.
• In an **Archive** album, it is not removed.
• In **Backup** or **Off**, nothing changes, but the choice is remembered.

Restore selects it automatically. Deselect it to let the file follow its album's mode again.
Optimise older photos and videos in your Camera folder

Only the **Camera folder** you chose in Settings under **Camera Sync** (“Camera Sync (Settings)”) has these controls.

## Selecting files

• **Select Photos/Videos older than:** **1 day** to **1 year**, or **All**.
• **Photos** and **Videos:** which kinds to select.
• Swipe a file right to select, left to deselect. The card shows how many are selected and the estimated saving.

## Buttons

• **Sync now:** backs up anything waiting in the folder, then optimises the selected files only.
• **Rescan:** checks the Cloud again.

## Good to know

• Only files OneDrive has confirmed at full size can be selected.
• Nothing is optimised until you press **Sync now**. New photos stay as they are.
• The Camera folder has no **Sync** mode, and the Optimise switches in Settings do not affect it.
• Leaving with changed choices asks whether to make them your defaults.
Selecting files in your Camera folder

Shows how many files are selected and the estimated space saved, or **Nothing selected**.

• **Photos**, **Videos** and the age select every match.
• Swipe right to select, left to deselect.
• **Sync now** optimises only the selected files.

A greyed file cannot be selected: it is not yet confirmed in OneDrive, or is already optimised. See “Optimise older photos and videos in your Camera folder”.
Duplicate album names detected

A single folder can end up recorded under two spellings that differ only in capital letters. GallerySync spots this, merges them into one album, and sets its mode to **Off** so you can choose fresh. **Dismiss** closes the card.\n\nThis is the only time the app sets a mode, and it can only set **Off**.
Archive this album?

Shown when you choose **Archive**:

• Archive checks all files are in the Cloud.
• Archived files move to your phone's Trash/Recycle Bin.
• Empty the bin to free the space.

**Archive** confirms; **Cancel** changes nothing.

## Good to know

You confirm once. Files added to the album later are covered too, until the album is empty. Android asks once per batch of up to 2,000 files. See “Android's own confirmation”.
Albums to Restore and Files in this album

• **Album list:** **Albums to Restore**, with how many albums have something to bring back.
• **Inside an album:** back arrow, album name, and **Files in this album** with the count and what you have selected.

A dash means the list is still loading. **Checking your Cloud for more...** means OneDrive is being read. A red message means a Cloud folder could not be reached.

The OneDrive list is remembered, and read again after ten minutes or when you press **Refresh**.
The message under the number

• **Swipe right to select / left to deselect. Tap to open.** on the album list.
• **Swipe right to select / left to deselect → Then press Restore.** inside an album.
• **Nothing in your Cloud is missing from this phone, so there is nothing to bring back.** when the list is empty.
• After a restore, how many files came back and how many were left unchanged.
N selected and how much to recover
The files selected across all albums, and the extra space they will take on your phone. Make sure you have that space free.
Refresh, Select all and Clear

• **Refresh** (album list): reads the list again, including OneDrive.
• **Select all** (inside an album): selects every file in it.
• **Clear:** removes every selection.

Greyed out while a restore is running.
Why are some files greyed out?

They are already on the phone at full size (same album, name and size), so there is nothing to restore. They are shown so the album matches your Cloud.\n\nA file with the same name but a different size is not offered: it may be an edit, and Restore never overwrites an edit.
Files to Archive

**Files to Archive**, with the number of files that will be archived: in every Archive album on the album list, or in the album you opened. Files you kept on the phone are not counted.\n\nBelow it: your Archive albums, and a reminder that archived files can be brought back on the **Restore** tab.
The Archive albums

One card per Archive album: how many files are waiting and their size, plus any kept, held back by the age filter, confirmed, or not confirmed.

• On the album list, the button reads **Check all albums** and checks every album.
• Tap an album to open it; **Check these files** then checks only that album.

Choosing an album removes nothing and does not change any mode.
Check these files, and what it reports

• **Check these files** (or **Check all albums**): starts the check.
• **Checking with your Cloud...** while the Cloud is asked.
• **Batch** progress while files are being removed.
• How many files were removed and the space freed, or **Nothing was removed.**

OneDrive is checked by listing each album's folder in OneDrive (name and size). Dropbox, Google Drive, pCloud, Backblaze B2 and IDrive e2 are asked about each file.

"Freeing" means after you empty the bin.
Only show files older than…

Limits this check to files at least that old: **1 hour** to **1 year**, or **All**. Newer files are greyed and left for a later check.\n\nIt starts at your default from Settings. Changing it here lasts for this visit only.
When there is nothing to archive

• **No album is set to Archive:** set one on the Albums tab.\n• **A zero:** everything in your Archive albums has already left the phone.\n• **This version of Android has no media trash:** Archive needs Android 11 or newer.
The file list and its marks

One card per file in your Archive albums.

## Keeping a file on the phone

Use it for a file you want to keep on the phone while the rest of the album is archived. Swipe **left** to keep it: it greys out and reads **Not archiving**, and is remembered. Swipe **right** to include it again. A file greyed as **too recent for your filter** is held back by the age filter.

## Marks

• **Spinner:** being checked, sent or removed.
• **Green check mark:** confirmed in your Cloud, or removed.
• **Red cross:** not confirmed; it stays on the phone.

## Messages

**Backing up...**, **Moving to Trash/Recycle Bin...**, **Removed from this phone.**, or in red why a file stays: **Could not check your Cloud**, **Not in your Cloud**, or **In your Cloud but the wrong size**.
The question: All files validated, or some validated

After the check:

• **All files validated:** every file is confirmed.
• **N files validated:** only those are confirmed; the rest stay on the phone.
• **Nothing can be archived:** none were confirmed. **Continue** closes the message.

**Yes** asks Android to move the confirmed files to the bin. **No** removes nothing. A large album may need several Android confirmations (2,000 files each).
Files ready to Archive (the leaving reminder)

Appears if you press Back to leave while files are confirmed and waiting to be archived.

• **Archive now:** opens the Archive tab.
• **Leave:** closes the app. Nothing is removed.

Counts OneDrive files only: only OneDrive copies are confirmed ahead of time. Other Clouds are checked when you press **Check these files**. The reminder does not appear if you press Home or swipe the app away.
General
The **How To Guide**, **Appearance** and **Use mobile data**. **Language** is the last line on the page.
Language
English only for now. **Multi-Language Support Coming Soon**.
Appearance

• **System** (default): follows your phone's light or dark setting.
• **Light** or **Dark**: always that look.

The guide and policy pages follow your phone's setting.
Use mobile data

• **Off** (default): **Wi-Fi only.**
• **On:** **Syncs on Wi-Fi and mobile data.**

Covers automatic backups and **Sync now**. Leave it off unless your data plan is unlimited.
Backup

• **Clouds:** connect or sign out of each Cloud. See “Your Clouds and Sign out”.
• **Where each folder goes:** which Cloud each folder sends to. See “Where each folder goes”.

One Cloud is marked **main (free)**: the first Cloud you selected. It is always free. Other Clouds need **Pro**: free for 30 days (**Start 30-day free trial**), then a one-time purchase (**Unlock Pro**). Nothing is charged automatically.
Your Clouds and Sign out

Each Cloud shows its account (or **Not connected**) with **Sign out**, **Connect** or **Enter keys**.

## Sign out

A warning first: backups to that Cloud stop, nothing is deleted. If that Cloud holds files that are not full size on the phone (optimised or archived), it asks:

• **Restore them to the phone first:** brings them all back, then signs out.
• **Leave them there:** signs out.
• **Cancel:** stays signed in.

Folders stay paired with that Cloud and wait until you sign in again. To send them elsewhere, change **Where each folder goes**.
Where each folder goes

Each top-level folder (DCIM, Pictures, Movies), the Cloud it goes to, and where in that Cloud.

• Tap the Cloud to change it. It can only be changed with more than one Cloud and Pro or the trial.
• Only new files follow a change. Files already sent stay where they are.
• A folder paired with an extra Cloud without Pro sends nothing, and says so.
Where new backups go (the Change dialog)

Not available in this version: new OneDrive backups go to **Samsung Gallery/DCIM**.\n\nWhen it returns: enter a OneDrive folder path or **Browse...** for one, **Reset to default** to go back to Samsung Gallery/DCIM, then **Use this folder** or **Cancel**. Files already backed up stay where they are.
Choose a folder (the OneDrive picker)
Not available in this version. Lists your OneDrive folders: tap to open, **Up one folder** to go back, **Use this folder** to choose, **New folder** to create one.
Albums
Which folders GallerySync watches, and what happens to Cloud copies when you delete from the phone. New albums always start at **Off**.
Folders to back up

The folders GallerySync may look in.

• **Add a folder:** opens Android's folder picker.
• **Remove:** select folders, press **Remove**, and confirm.

Nothing outside these folders is scanned or changed. Removing a folder loses nothing: add it back and everything returns.
Stop watching this folder?
**Remove** stops watching the selected folders; **Cancel** changes nothing.\n\nNothing already backed up is lost. Adding the folder back restores its albums and history, with nothing sent twice.
When you delete a photo or video from this phone

• **Leave the Cloud copy** (default): nothing is ever removed from your Cloud.
• **Ask me about the Cloud copy:** when files leave your phone, a window asks what to do with their Cloud copies. If notifications are allowed, you are also told shortly after deleting. Nothing is removed without your say-so. See “Files deleted from your phone (the window that opens with the app)”.

OneDrive only for now. Copies in other Clouds are never removed.
Files deleted from your phone (the window that opens with the app)

Opens before the Albums tab when files have left your phone, under **Ask**. Nothing is selected to start with.

## Window 1: a copy is in OneDrive

Swipe right (or tap) to select files whose OneDrive copy should go.

• **Remove N from OneDrive:** asks you to confirm, then moves those copies to the OneDrive recycle bin. Unselected files stay in OneDrive. See “Remove files from OneDrive? (the confirmation)”.
• **Keep all in OneDrive.**
• **Decide later.**

## Window 2: no copy found

These files are still in your phone's trash.

• **Back up N to OneDrive:** sends the selected files from the trash. Nothing is deleted.
• **Leave all in the trash.**
• **Decide later.**

## Good to know

• Undecided files stay on the list until you decide.
• Not listed: files Archive removed, photos edited in place, and files deleted outright with no Cloud copy.
• If more than half of your backed-up files seem to vanish at once, nothing is offered; it is treated as a faulty scan rather than real deletions.
• Back does the same as **Decide later**.
Remove files from OneDrive? (the confirmation)

Shows how many files and their size. They go to the OneDrive recycle bin, which GallerySync never empties.\n\n**Remove from OneDrive** goes ahead; **Cancel** decides nothing. Any file that has come back to the phone is left alone.
Sync
How photos and videos in **Sync** albums are optimised. Files change only after the Cloud has verified them. Works with OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, pCloud, IDrive e2 and Backblaze B2.
Optimise photos

**Off** by default. When on, photos in Sync albums are replaced with smaller copies: about 2048 pixels on the long edge, roughly a tenth of the size. They stay in your gallery with a small cloud badge. Originals stay in the Cloud.\n\nPhotos already small enough, and files set to **Keep at full size**, are left alone. **Mode** sets when it runs. See “Mode: Automatic or Manual”.
Optimise video

**Off** by default. When on, shows **Mode**, **Older than** and **Compression**.

Videos in Sync albums are re-encoded smaller. Nothing is ever cut. Originals stay in the Cloud.

## Which videos

In a Sync album, verified in the Cloud, older than your setting, in a folder you gave access to, and not already optimised.

## When

• **Automatic:** after backups, only while charging.
• **Manual:** when you press **Sync now**.
Mode: Automatic or Manual

• **Automatic** (default): files in Sync albums are optimised once the Cloud confirms them. Video waits for the charger.
• **Manual:** nothing happens until you press **Sync now** on the Albums tab.

Photos outside the folders you gave access to need Android's confirmation, so they wait until you open the app or press **Sync now**.
Older than (video)

How old a video must be before it is optimised: **Straight away**, **1 hour**, **12 hours**, **1 day** or **1 week**. Backup is not delayed.\n\n**Straight away** includes clips shot today; editing one starts from the smaller copy until you restore it.
Compression (video)

• **High compression, 480p:** smallest files, about 85% saved.
• **Medium compression, 720p:** about 75% saved.
• **Low compression, 1080p:** about 50% saved.

Typical figures; results vary.

## After you make it stronger

The app asks **Re-optimise existing videos?** **Yes** lets videos that were too small to shrink before be tried again. **No** leaves them. Already optimised videos are not touched.
Restore (Settings)
One switch for the Restore tab: **Show empty folders**.
Show empty folders
**Off** by default. When on, the Restore tab lists every OneDrive folder, including ones with nothing to bring back.
Camera Sync (Settings)

**Special settings for Camera**, off by default. When on:

• **Camera folder:** the folder your camera saves to. Choose it from the list, or **Other…**.
• **Select Photos/Videos older than**, **Photos**, **Videos:** defaults for that folder's optimise controls (“Optimise older photos and videos in your Camera folder”).
• **Video compression:** for videos optimised there.

The Camera folder has no **Sync** mode, and nothing is optimised until you press **Sync now** in it. The Optimise switches above do not affect it.
Archive (Settings)

• **Only show files older than:** where the Archive tab\'s filter starts. See “Only show files older than (Settings)”.\n• **Notify when files are ready to archive:** off by default. See “Notify when files are ready to archive”.
Only show files older than (Settings)

Where the Archive tab\'s age filter starts: **1 hour**, **1 day**, **1 week**, **1 month**, **1 year** or **All** (default). Changing it on the Archive tab lasts for that visit only. See “Only show files older than…”.
Notify when files are ready to archive

**Off** by default. When on, you are notified once per new batch of files ready to archive. OneDrive files only.\n\nThe Albums tab and the leaving reminder show this too, so you are never relying on notifications alone. If notifications are blocked, the switch says so.
GallerySync cannot see my photos

A message at the top of the Albums tab means GallerySync does not have full access to your photos:

• **GallerySync needs access to your photos:** no access was given, or it was taken away.
• **Only some photos are shared:** access was limited with **Select photos**, so backups are incomplete.

Press **Grant access** and choose **Allow all**. If no prompt appears: phone **Settings → Apps → GallerySync → Permissions → Photos and videos**.
